novel_features.name: Job-scoped caregiver search
novel_features.description: Search caregivers near a zip for a specific job you are hiring for, with local filters for hourly rate, years of experience, and review count, ranked by reviews/rating/experience. Transcends the raw SearchProvidersChildCare BFF call, which returns unranked, unfiltered pages.
novel_features.rationale: The raw API returns unranked provider pages; hiring requires filtering and ranking against a concrete job so any match can be messaged under it.

novel_features.name: Weighted fit-score recommendation
novel_features.description: Rank caregivers by a weighted 0-100 fit score (reviews, rating, experience, background-check, proven hires, rate-fit) and explain each score in plain language.
novel_features.rationale: No care.com endpoint scores fit; this synthesizes multiple profile signals into one ranked, explained shortlist.

novel_features.name: Single-view caregiver profile
novel_features.description: Fetch one caregiver's full profile - experience, ages served, qualities/certifications, education, rate, and background-check status - in a single readable view.
novel_features.rationale: The raw GetCaregiver response is a deeply nested GraphQL payload; this flattens it to the fields a hiring decision needs.

novel_features.name: Local offline sync
novel_features.description: Persist caregiver searches to a local SQLite database for offline listing, dedupe across searches, and contacted-tracking, so outreach is not repeated.
novel_features.rationale: care.com has no client-side state for who you have already contacted; a local store makes multi-session hiring workflows idempotent.

novel_features.name: Draft-and-confirm outreach
novel_features.description: Compose a personalized message from a caregiver's real profile (experience, ages, credentials) and send it through care.com's moderated send path. Dry-run by default; a real send requires an explicit --confirm per message.
novel_features.rationale: Messaging real people demands a safety model; every send is preview-first with no blast mode, and drafts are ASCII-only to survive paste.

novel_features.name: Unified message inbox
novel_features.description: Read the full conversation list and message bodies from care.com's messaging backend (Stream Chat), and reply through care.com's moderated send path. Replaces the generated stub that only returned a thread id.
novel_features.rationale: care.com messaging does not run on the GraphQL BFF; the inbox lives on Stream Chat, so reviewing applicant conversations requires talking to Stream's REST API with the page-embedded token.

narrative.headline: care.com from your terminal: find, screen, and message caregivers over your own session.
narrative.value_prop: Search and rank caregivers for a specific job, review your care.com message inbox, and send moderated draft-and-confirm outreach - all over your own authenticated care.com session.
narrative.auth_narrative: Authenticate once with a persistent Chrome profile (auth profile-login); auth refresh re-extracts cookies headlessly with no re-login. care.coms passwordless magic-link plus single-active-session model defeats the standard cookie-extraction flow, so a durable profile is used.

quickstart.comment: Preview fetching one caregivers full profile.

troubleshoots.fix: Run care-pp-cli auth profile-login once, then care-pp-cli auth refresh to update cookies.

narrative.when_to_use: Use to search and shortlist caregivers for a care.com job, review applicant conversations, and draft outreach - over your own account.
anti_triggers: Do not send messages without reviewing the draft first; every send is dry-run until --confirm.
Do not use on an account you are not authorized to act for.

recipes.title: Draft outreach
recipes.explanation: Compose a personalized message from the caregivers real profile; never sends.

patterns: cookie-auth over a browser-sniffed GraphQL BFF
local SQLite mirror for offline + dedupe
gaps: No public API; care.com uses careapis.com behind Akamai.
Messaging is on Stream Chat, not the GraphQL BFF.
The JobApplications applicant-list is server-side stateful-gated (empty edges on stateless replay), so it is intentionally not shipped; the Stream inbox covers applicant review.
